top_categories.workout_context: 200 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.

Road-specific control matters at Dartmoor Legend Ultra Sportive. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 200 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Dartmoor Legend Ultra Sportive's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
At Dartmoor Legend Ultra Sportive, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 200 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
18,000ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
18,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
90ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
200 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 18,000ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Dartmoor Legend Ultra Sportive. Train it until it feels boring.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Dartmoor Legend Ultra Sportive. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.nutrition: Ultra-distance fueling for 200 miles: 80–100g carbs/hour from mile 1 — don’t wait until you’re hungry. Practice your exact race-day nutrition in every long training ride. Carry backup calories. 200 miles burns 8,000–12,000+ calories — you cannot replace them all, but you must try.
race_overlay.altitude: Dartmoor Legend Ultra Sportive includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The technical descents at Dartmoor Legend Ultra Sportive demand practice on similar paved roads. Ride mixed terrain at race-day cadence weekly. Practice braking points, corner entry, line choice, and accelerating smoothly out of turns. Confirm tire pressure and equipment before race week.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 200 miles of mixed terrain in Exeter Racecourse, Kennford, Exeter, Devon, EX6 7XS, England.
